 Q 2 Results Today, 12th November 2026 Live Updates: Some of the prominent companies announcing their Q2 FY27 results on November 12 include Hindustan Aeronautics, Alkem Laboratories, Amber Enterprises India, Bharat Dynamics, Vodafone Idea, Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC), Oil India, NMDC, Page Industries, Hitachi Energy India, Manappuram Finance, Ola Electric Mobility, Rail Vikas Nigam, Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care, and Travel Food Services.
 Stay tuned to businessline for more.
 FILTERS UPDATES ALL quarterly results stock up November 12, 2026 13:56 Quarterly results
 Alkem Laboratories Q2 results live: Profit dips
 Alkem Laboratories posted standalone PAT of Rs 762.5 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 786.7 crore in Q2FY26.
 Shares down 4% to Rs 5,234 on the NSE.
 November 12, 2026 13:48 Quarterly results
 Procter & Gamble Q2 results live: Management commentary
 “We continue to invest strategically in our brands, innovation and market capabilities, even as the macro-economic landscape remains challenging. We continue to believe that our strategic priorities, combined with the strength of our brands and organizational capabilities, position us well to leverage future growth opportunities and create sustainable long-term value for all our stakeholders. We are excited about the future. 
 We are confident in our Integrated Growth Strategy of a focused product portfolio of daily use categories where performance drives brand choice, superiority (of product performance, packaging, brand communication, retail execution and value), productivity, constructive disruption, and an agile and accountable organization; to deliver balanced growth and value creation.” 
 - Kumar Venkatasubramanian, Managing Director, Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care
 November 12, 2026 13:47 Quarterly results

 Procter & Gamble Hygiene’s profit dipped 6.6% to Rs 195.84 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 209.86 crore in Q2FY26.

 Network People Services Technologies Limited’s (NPST) Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results .

 * Q2 FY27 total income grew 50% YoY to ₹72.95 crore, up 19% QoQ
